_about: Facts scripts/test_report.py cannot measure. Edit, commit, and the next report picks them up. Leave a field empty rather than guess: the report then says it is missing.

known_issues.issue: One Turso group token opens every tenant database
known_issues.impact: Isolation between customers relies on backend code only; a leaked token or compromised backend exposes all customers
known_issues.fix: One token per customer database (Turso supports it)

known_issues.issue: More than 100 customers active at once (DB_MAX_CACHED_TENANTS)
known_issues.impact: The oldest database client is closed, possibly mid-query, causing errors
known_issues.fix: Close a client only when idle, or raise the limit

known_issues.impact: 10 wrong passwords lock a known user out for 15 minutes
known_issues.fix: Also limit per IP address, or a CAPTCHA after several failures

known_issues.issue: Deploy script picks MADLAD 10b on GPU hosts

known_issues.impact: Low while login uses a bearer header, but any website can call the API from a browser
known_issues.fix: Allow only the app's own domain
